en.title: Adjacent Token Score
en.description:
A row has n cells; each cell has a value points[i], and its state is T if it holds a token or E if it is empty. Each T cell contributes its own value; each pair of adjacent T cells contributes an extra 1 point. Find the total score.

This problem uses the standard I/O format prepared by CSWork; the rules, constraints, and two public examples correspond to the original Barclays problem.
en.input: The first line contains n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100); the second line contains n integers points[i] (1 ≤ points[i] ≤ 1000); the third line contains a string of length n consisting only of E and T.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: In example 1 the tokens are in cells 0, 3, 4; the base score is 3+2+3=8, and the adjacent pair (3,4) adds 1, for a total of 9.
hints: First add up the values of all T cells, then check every pair of adjacent cells to see whether both are T. k consecutive T cells contribute k−1 adjacent pairs, not just a single bonus.
